svg.text: a new store adds a provider and ZERO screens
its sync is a human typing
— it is not written per store
A screen never talks to a provider. A provider never talks to a screen. Between them sits the Store — which is why the offline contract is STRUCTURAL rather than a feature that had to be added.
Everything downstream reads Capabilities, never ProviderID. An is_physical boolean would force every new feature to remember a special case — and eventually one would not.
Interface segregation. A new store adds a provider and no screens.
